Checking whether the buzz's deep link 'opens the board', I got HTTP 200 -- and my nonexistent-route control (/zzz-no-such-route-9999) returned HTTP 200 as well. The catch-all makes the instrument undiscriminating, exactly as comp-routes' own coverage line warns ('a catch-all match is a DEFAULT, not a resolution'). THE BUZZ HAS NO ASCII CONTROL, and a passing observation was being attributed to one. BG's readback credited 'AE~Z's ensure_ascii doing its job' for the post body being pure ASCII. Exercised at source: the composer performs ZERO ascii coercion, and a fixture ticket carrying a client's smart quotes and em dash composes to a buzz containing 0x2014/0x2019/0x201c/0x201d; json.dumps escapes them on the WIRE but the server decodes them back, so transport escaping is not a content filter. Today's body was ASCII because DT~Z typed ASCII. Not a defect in the channel (Teams renders it fine) -- but the standing property does not exist, and the first client who types a smart quote will disprove it.

A FALSE PREMISE OF MY OWN, corrected in this instance after it had already been validated (@c02f8022d0): I wrote that the water test's fire happened with the Analyst seat DOWN, and called it 'MEASURED, not assumed' because I had read NOT REGISTERED on the broker. The reading was true; the inference was not -- 'measured' claimed a discrimination the instrument never performed. ⛔ AND THE FIRST FIX WAS ITSELF DEFECTIVE, which is the more instructive half: I explained the false reading with a periodic-heartbeat mechanism relayed to me as GROUNDED, and quoted its memorable line into this contract. THE MECHANISM WAS RETRACTED IN FULL ~40 MINUTES LATER (@07b0063f34) -- it never fit its own evidence (observed NOT REGISTERED vs a contract describing STALE; the broker source unread). So inside one hour this instance carried a false premise, then a correction resting on a false mechanism. What stands now is observation without cause (repeated NOT REGISTERED on a continuously-live PID, independently witnessed, cause UNDETERMINED and held at Andrew), which is all the correction ever needed. THE LESSON I OWE THE RECORD: I accepted a mechanism because it arrived with the word GROUNDED on it and because it was well-phrased -- the same credulity I had corrected in another seat's ensure_ascii attribution three hours earlier, and a good sentence propagates faster than its evidence. IT IS THE SAME SHAPE AS THE ensure_ascii ATTRIBUTION I CORRECTED IN ANOTHER SEAT AN HOUR EARLIER -- a true observation with an invented mechanism -- and I wrote mine into a machine-readable completion contract, which is the worse surface for it. Neither criterion turns on it (unattendedness rests on the scheduler plane), and the corrected causality makes the consumer-gap exclusion stronger, not weaker.
